entry.title: MPC MIDI Converter 1.0.0
entry.summary: First release of MPC MIDI Converter: turns MIDI files into MPC patterns right on the MPC, with no computer. ## What's in it - File browser for the MPC's drives (SD card, internal drive, USB): tap to highlight, tap again to open a folder or convert a file - **Convert File**, and **Convert Folder** for a whole pack, including folders inside it (4 levels deep), keeping the pack's folder structure - Patterns are saved in a **MIDI Converts** folder at the top of the drive the MIDI files are on; the s
